description: Sample dashboard for viewing Azure IoT Operations health and usage

options.content: AIO Health Model

panels.description: Health Status of the MQTT Broker as perceived by the Diagnostics Probe
panels.title: AIO Broker Health [$cluster]

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  sum by (_) (
    1 - max_over_time(
      aio_dataflow_reconcile_errors{cluster="$cluster"}[1m]
    )
  ),
  "_",
  "Operator Health",
  "__name__",
  ".*"
)
OR on() vector(1)

panels.description:
Including:
- Backpressure
- Authentication Failures
- Authorization Failures
- Dropped QoS0 Messages
- Dataflow Errors
- Connector Errors

targets.expr:
sum by(_)(label_replace(
        0 < increase(aio_broker_authentication_failures{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m:1m])
    ,'_','Broker:authn_failure','','')) or
sum by(_)(label_replace(
        0 < increase(aio_broker_authorization_failures{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m:1m])
    ,'_','Broker:authz_failure','','')) or
sum by(_)(label_replace(
        0 < increase(aio_broker_backpressure_packets_rejected_memory{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m:1m])
    ,'_','Broker:backpressure_memory','','')) or
sum by(_)(label_replace(
        0 < increase(aio_broker_backpressure_packets_rejected_disk{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m:1m])
    ,'_','Broker:backpressure_disk','','')) or
sum by(_)(label_replace(
        0 < increase(aio_broker_qos0_messages_dropped{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m:1m])
    ,'_','Broker:qos0_msgs_dropped','','')) or
vector(0) > 0

panels.title: Service Errors [$cluster]

targets.expr:
## Workload Readiness health
############################
label_replace(min(
avg(label_join( # Workload ready percents (for deployment, daemonset, and statefulset)
    label_replace(label_join(
        kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"} or
        kube_daemonset_status_number_ready{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespacem"} or
        kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}
        ,"workloadName", "", "deployment", "daemonset", "statefulset")
        ,"workloadType", "$1", "__name__", "kube_(.*)_status_.*")
  / label_replace(label_join(
        kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"} or
        kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"} or
        kube_statefulset_status_replicas{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}
        ,"workloadName", "", "deployment", "daemonset", "statefulset")
        ,"workloadType", "$1", "__name__", "kube_(.*)_(status|spec)_.*")
  ,"workload", ":", "workloadType", "workloadName")
) by (workload) >=0 
) or vector(404),"_","AIO Workload Readiness","","")

## Container Restart Health:
############################
label_replace(
  sgn(sum_over_time(sum(rate(
    kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[10m:1m]
    )*60)[1h:]) > 5) * 0.0 # RED: Cumulative restarts over X(5) time greater than Y(1h)
  or sgn(max(
    kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}
    + 1 >= 0))
  ,"_","AIO Container Restarts","","")

## Container CPU top-level health
################################
label_replace(
min(sgn( # Check for throttling > N indicating container is exceeding its CPU limits
      rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!=""}[10m]) 
    / rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!=""}[10m])
    >= 0.80)
    ) 
    * 0.0
or
min(
    sgn(min(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",resource="cpu"}) by (namespace,container))
    )
,"_","AIO Container CPU","","")

## Container Memory Health:
###########################
label_replace(
min( # Look for high memory utilization
    0.0 * sgn((
        max(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!=""}) by (namespace,container)
      / min(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",resource="memory"}) by (namespace, container)
    ) >= .95) or # show health state of 0 if container memory utilization >= 95%
    vector(0)>0
)
or
min(
    sgn(min(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",container!="",resource="memory"}) by (namespace,container))
)
,"_","AIO Container Memory","","")

label_replace(sum (
    label_replace(label_join(
        kube_daemonset_status_number_ready{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",daemonset=~".*"} or
        kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",deployment=~".*"} or
        kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",statefulset=~".*"}
        ,"workloadName", "", "deployment", "daemonset", "replicaset", "statefulset")
        ,"workloadType", "$1", "__name__", "kube_(.*)_status_.*")
),"_","Ready","","")

# Container Restarts
label_replace(ceil(sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~".*"}[$__rate_interval]))),"_","Restarts","","") > 0
(label_replace(sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~".*",container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))*1000,"_","CPU Usage (milli-cores)","","") )
(label_replace(sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~".*",container!=""})/(1024*1024),"_","Mem Working Bytes (MB)","","") )

# Node Health Status
####################
label_replace(
  sum(
    max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{cluster="$cluster",condition="ready",status="false"} > 0) * 0 or
    max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{cluster="$cluster",condition="ready",status="true"} > 0) * 1
  ) / sum(kube_node_info{cluster="$cluster"})
  ,"_","Node Readiness","","")

#############################
# Node CPU Health
label_replace(min(
# BEGIN inner query
min by(_)(label_replace(vector(0)>0
    or 0.0 * sgn(
        100 - ((avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster",mode="idle"}[5m])) 
              + avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster",mode="iowait"}[5m]))
        ) * 100) > 90)
    or 1.0 * sgn(sum by (instance)(node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster"} > 0))
    or -1 * sgn(max by (instance) (label_replace(kube_node_info{cluster="$cluster"},"instance","$1","node","(.*)")))
    ,"_","$1","instance","(.*)"))
# END inner query
),"_","Node CPU", "","")

#############################
# Node Memory Health
label_replace(min(
# BEGIN inner query
min by(_)(label_replace(vector(0)>0
    or 0.0 * sgn(
        (100 * sum by (instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} - (node_memory_MemFree_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} + node_memory_Buffers_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} + node_memory_Cached_bytes{cluster="$cluster"})) / sum by(instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster="$cluster"})) > 90)
    or 1.0 * sgn(sum by (instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} > 0))
    or -1 * sgn(max by (instance) (label_replace(kube_node_info{cluster="$cluster"},"instance","$1","node","(.*)")))
,"_","$1","instance","(.*)"))
# END inner query
),"_","Node Memory", "","")

#############################
# Disk Usage Health
label_replace(min(
# BEGIN inner query
min by(node)(label_replace(vector(0)>0
  or 0.0 * sgn(max by(instance) (100 - (100 * node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} 
            / node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}) > 10) > 90)
  or 1.0 * sgn(max by(instance) (100 - (100 * node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} 
            / node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster="$cluster"})))
,"node","$1","instance","(.*)"))
or max by (node) (kube_node_info{cluster="$cluster"}) * -1 # Baseline by node
# END inner query
),"_","Node Disk", "","")

#############################
# Node CPU Usage Pecent
max by (node) (label_replace(
  100 - ((avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster",mode="idle"}[5m])) 
        + avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster",mode="iowait"}[5m]))
  ) * 100)
  #* on (instance) group_left(node) label_replace(max by(internal_ip,node) (kube_node_info),"instance","$1:9100","internal_ip","(.*)") # Node Info
  ,"node","$1","instance","(.*)")
)

#############################
# Disk Usage
max by (node,device) (label_replace(
  #min by(instance,device) (100 - (100 * node_filesystem_free_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}) > 5)
  min by(instance,device) (100 - (100 * node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster="$cluster"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}) > 10)
    #* on (instance) group_left(node) label_replace(max by(internal_ip,node) (kube_node_info),"instance","$1:9100","internal_ip","(.*)") # Node Info
      ,"node","$1","instance","(.*)")
)
#or label_replace(vector(60),"threshold","redline","","")

sum by(category)(
    label_replace(
        rate(aio_broker_publishes_received{cluster='$cluster',category!=''}[1m]) * 60
    ,'_',' $1','category','(.*)')
)

sum by(category)(
    label_replace(
        rate(aio_broker_payload_bytes_received{cluster='$cluster',category!=''}[1m]) * 60
    ,'_',' $1','category','(.*)')
)
